And he {{ls}}ought opportunitie to betray him apart from the multitudes.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=7}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26. 17. Mr. 14, 12.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ {{sc|Mavndy}} Thur{{ls}}day.}}∷ And the day of the Azymes came, vvherein it vvas nece{{ls}}{{ls}}arie that the Pa{{ls}}che {{ls}}hould be killed. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=8}} And he {{ls}}ent Peter and Iohn, {{ls}}aying, Goe and prepare vs the Pa{{ls}}che, that vve may eate. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=9}} But they {{ls}}aid, VVhere vvilt thou that vve prepare it? {{verse|chapter=22|verse=10}} And he {{ls}}aid to them, Behold, as you enter into the citie, there {{ls}}hal meete you a man carying a pitcher of vvater: folovv him into the hou{{ls}}e into vvhich he entreth, {{verse|chapter=22|verse=11}} and you {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ay to the good man of the hou{{ls}}e, The Mai{{ls}}ter {{ls}}aith to thee, VVhere is the inne vvhere I may eate the Pa{{ls}}che vvith my Di{{ls}}ciples? {{verse|chapter=22|verse=12}} And he vvil {{ls}}hevv you a great refectorie adorned: and there prepare. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=13}} And they going, found as he {{ls}}aid to them, and prepared the Pa{{ls}}che.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=14}} And vvhen the houre was come, he {{ls}}ate dovvne, and the tvvelue Apo{{ls}}tles vvith him. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=15}} And he {{ls}}aid to them, {{sup|‖}} VVith de{{ls}}ire I haue de{{ls}}ired to eate this Pa{{ls}}che vvith you before I {{ls}}uffer. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=16}} For I {{ls}}ay to you, that from this time I vvil not eate it, til it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=17}} And {{sup|‖}} taking the chalice he gaue thankes, and {{ls}}aid, Take and deuide among you, {{verse|chapter=22|verse=18}} for I {{ls}}ay to you, That I vvil not drinke of the generation of the vine, til the kingdom of God doe come.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=19}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 26. Mr. 14, 22. 1. Cor. 11, 24.''}}* And taking bread, he gaue thankes, and brake: and gaue to them, {{ls}}aying, {{sup|‖}} {{sc|This is my body {{sup|‖}} vvhich is given for yov}}. {{sup|‖}} Doe this {{sup|‖}} for a commemoration of me. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=20}} In like maner the chalice al{{ls}}o, after he had {{ls}}upped, {{ls}}aying, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Greeke is here {{ls}}o plaine, that there was very bloud in the chalice, {{ls}}hed for vs, that Beza {{ls}}aith it is a corruption in the greeke. See the Annota. vpon this place.}}∷ {{sc|This is the chalice {{sup|‖}} the nevv testament in my blovd, {{sup|‖}} vvhich shal be shed for yov}}.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=21}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 21. Mr. 14, 20. Io. 13, 18.''}}* But yet behold, the hand of him that betraieth me, is vvith me on the table. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=22}} And the Sonne of man in deede<noinclude>{{continues|goeth}}</noinclude>
